items.name: HL · Monday payment reminders
items.what: Every Monday at 09:00, removes paid customers from the unpaid invoices with Merge, sets aside rows with no phone, writes reminders to a Sent log in batches of 20 with a 60-second wait, and emails Tolu one summary.
setup: Create one Google Sheet with tabs Invoices (invoice_id, customer_id, name, phone, amount, pay_link, status), Payments (reference, customer_id, amount, paid_at), Fix list (same columns as Invoices) and Sent log (customer_id, phone, message, sent_at). Test data only.
Create a Google Sheets OAuth2 credential called "Google Sheets" and select it in Invoices, Payments, Fix list and Send (log).
Create a Gmail OAuth2 credential called "Gmail" and select it in Summary email.
Replace YOUR_SHEET_ID in all four Google Sheets nodes with your sheet's ID.
Replace YOUR_EMAIL in Summary email with the address that should receive the summary (your own while testing).
Invoices and Payments have pinned sample data for building; unpin them to read your real sheets.
For testing, set Loop Over Items batch size to 2 and Wait 60 s to 5 seconds; set them back to 20 and 60 before you save and publish.
items.test: With the pinned data and batch size 2, wait 5 s, click Execute workflow: Chef Tunde (who paid) is skipped, Mr Okafor (no phone) lands on the Fix list, the other three get rows in the Sent log with sent_at times in clusters of two about 5 seconds apart, and exactly one summary email arrives saying Reminders sent: 3.

walk.title: Build it: polite reminders, paced, payers skipped
walk.sample: Five unpaid invoices · Chef Tunde has paid since · Mr Okafor has no phone · batch size 2, wait 5 seconds for testing

steps.say: Every Monday at nine, one trigger starts two sources side by side.
The first source is every unpaid invoice. Pin its output while you build.
show: Google Sheets › Get Row(s) · Sheet: Invoices

steps.say: The second is the payments log, so we can see who has paid since the invoice went out.
show: Google Sheets › Get Row(s) · Sheet: Payments

steps.say: Merge crosses off the payers. Match on customer ID, never on names, because there can be two Mrs Adebayos.
Keep only the non-matches, with data from Input one: invoices with no payment. Payers are removed before a single message is built.
An IF checks there's a phone number to reach.
Anyone without a number goes on the Fix list for Tolu, so nobody is silently dropped.
Now pace the sending. Loop Over Items hands out batches of twenty, from the provider's limit, not a guess. For testing, use two.
From the loop output, build a gentle reminder with the name, invoice number, amount and the pay link.
For practice, Send only writes to a Sent log with a timestamp. No message reaches a customer until we swap in a real messaging node.
Wait sixty seconds, inside the loop. Then drag Wait's output back into Loop Over Items, or only the first batch ever goes.
show: Wait → back into Loop Over Items

steps.say: The done output fires once after the last batch, carrying every item. Turn on Execute Once, so Tolu gets one summary, not one per customer.
When the test looks right, put the batch back to twenty and the wait to sixty seconds, then save and publish.

walk.end: Run it with the pinned data, then check the Sent log times come in clusters of two and exactly one summary arrives.
